what: The video's override moment, with the close knob at 30 per 1,000 (the default, 20, closes no attack on this queue). C0072 is one of the 4 attacks the desk wrongly closes at 30: a UDP-bypass-v1 flood. An analyst spot-checking closed cases relabels it; the nearby-attack rule then stops the desk from auto-closing three look-alike flows, which go to the analyst instead. Those three are benign in the dataset, so the cost is three extra decisions, not three caught attacks. scripts/record_agent.py --demo-path records model runs for exactly these states.
